page.layout: One column of verse below a centred title. A decorated initial S stands at the left of the first stanza. No margin notes. At the foot, right of centre, a signature mark.

main_text.head: PROTREPTICON AD HIEROPOLIN.
main_text.p: SANCTE audi: sancto facilis precor annue voto Magne opifex, cuius non enarrabile nomen, Et caelum, ac miseri confusa potentia regni Lucifugum, & mundi bruta haec elementa tremiscunt:

Quem Natura tremit venerans, vltróque fatetur Te Regem Authorémque suum, qui numine comples Omnia; Regem, vno quo iudice stántque cadúntque Res hominum, morbo iaceant, seu luce fruantur; Seu bellum pacémue feras, & gaudia vitæ.

p.i: Tu vero Alme, sacri arcano qui luminis imbre Cuncta foues, feruas & alis, solidáque serenas Lætitia, & castus renouas mortalia corda, Illucesce meæ totúsque illabere menti Irradians, & luce tuâ sua nubila differ.

Hauriat ex te illos precor, ô precor hauriat ignes, Viuificos ignes tenebrosa: agè discute noctem, Et præluce intus, ne pes me lubricus imas Auferat in tenebras, & desolata nocentum Antra, bonúsque tuo æternùm me lumine deduc.

Alme faue, & sanctis præsens allabere cœptis: Munere Sancte tuo, mihi casta Poetica mentem Excitet immersam tenebris, dubiúmque mone me Quid sequar: & quæcunque mihi se tramite cæco Ostendet via difficilis, me numine firma Præsenti, dum Sancte nouos tibi molior orsus, Dum iuuat Aonio Latias de vertice Musas Sacra per, & sacros longè deducere saltus.

Nam quid enim:ecce nouos in me sacer impetus ignes Præcipitat, spirántque nouum noua pectora numen. En nuper fandi indocilis, iam pectore magnos Concipio sensus: prior illa euanuit omnis Impietas, & vita olim iuuenilibus annis

page.notes: Printed initial S is a decorative woodcut; read as the first letter of SANCTE. Dash ornaments at the right end of the fourth line are not text. The "enim:ecce" line reads as printed; the mark between enim and ecce may be a colon or a question mark [?]. Italic and roman choices for some stanzas are approximate from the scan. No page number or running head is printed; the title serves as the page head.
